Container.Name: DockSentinel
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: docker vulnerability trivy scanner security cve
Container.Overview: DockSentinel monitors Docker images for known vulnerabilities using Trivy, tracks findings over time and sends deduplicated ntfy alerts. It only reads Docker metadata and never starts, stops or removes containers. The image is published at ghcr.io/luriot/docksentinel. Docker socket access is privileged: prefer TLS remote endpoints when possible. The template already passes --group-add=281 (Unraid's Docker socket group); if your socket uses another GID, adjust Extra Parameters (check it on the host with: stat -c '%g' /var/run/docker.sock).
Container.Requires: Docker Engine and a writable appdata folder. Docker socket access is privileged.
Container.Description: DockSentinel monitors Docker images for known vulnerabilities with Trivy, tracks finding lifecycle and prioritisation, and sends optional ntfy alerts. It discovers containers and images across one or more Docker endpoints and never starts, stops or modifies containers. The image is public at ghcr.io/luriot/docksentinel. Docker socket access is privileged; prefer a read-only socket mapping, a socket proxy, or mutual-TLS remote endpoints. First-run setup uses a one-time code printed in the container log. Includes a guided Docker setup, finding triage/export, backups and system status.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent database, encryption key and Trivy vulnerability database cache. Back this up.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Local Docker Engine API. This is effectively privileged access to the host; DockSentinel only performs read-only calls. Remove this mapping if you only use remote TLS endpoints.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for the application process.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for the application process and appdata ownership.

Config.Name: Setup token
Config.Description: Optional first-run setup token. Leave blank to have a random token printed in the container log on first start.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: trace, debug, info, warn, error or fatal.

Config.Name: Log retention days
Config.Description: Days of dated text logs kept in /data/logs (one file per day).

Config.Name: Backup interval (hours)
Config.Description: Automatic database snapshot interval in hours; 0 disables automatic backups.

Config.Name: Backup retention
Config.Description: Number of snapshots kept in /data/backups; older ones are removed.

Config.Name: Trust proxy
Config.Description: Set true only behind a trusted reverse proxy that sets X-Forwarded-* headers.

Config.Name: Cookie secure
Config.Description: auto, always or never. Use always when serving over HTTPS.
